scheme_name: Financial Assistance (Kanyadaan) on the Occasion of Marriage of Daughter- Haryana Silicosis Board
description:
The Financial Assistance Scheme for Kanyadaan on the Occasion of Marriage of Daughter is a welfare initiative launched by the Haryana Silicosis Board. 

This scheme aims to provide financial support to families affected by silicosis, a debilitating lung disease caused by inhaling silica dust. 

The scheme was officially launched on 1st January 2019. 

It was introduced to alleviate the financial burden on families who are often unable to afford the expenses associated with their daughter's marriage due to the economic impact of silicosis. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to ensure that daughters of silicosis-affected families can have a dignified marriage. 

The scheme aims to provide a one-time financial assistance of ₹51,000. 

This amount is intended to cover various expenses related to the marriage ceremony, including but not limited to, the cost of the wedding venue, catering, and other necessary arrangements. 

The financial assistance is specifically targeted at families whose primary breadwinner has been diagnosed with silicosis. 

To be eligible for this scheme, the applicant must be a resident of Haryana. 

The applicant must have a daughter who is getting married. 

The financial assistance is available only to families where the head of the family has been diagnosed with silicosis and is registered with the Haryana Silicosis Board. 

There are specific income criteria that must be met to qualify for this assistance. 

The annual income of the family should not exceed ₹3 lakh. 

This income limit is set to ensure that the assistance reaches those who are genuinely in need. 

The applicant must also provide proof of the marriage date, which should be within six months of applying for the assistance. 

The application process is straightforward and designed to be user-friendly. 

Interested applicants must fill out the application form available on the official website of the Haryana Silicosis Board. 

The application form requires the applicant to provide personal details such as name, address, and details of the daughter who is getting married. 

Additionally, the applicant must submit a copy of the silicosis diagnosis certificate issued by a recognized medical authority. 

Proof of income must also be submitted, which can include income certificates or pay slips. 

A copy of the marriage invitation card is required to confirm the date of the wedding. 

Once the application is completed, it must be submitted to the local office of the Haryana Silicosis Board. 

The local office will review the application and verify the documents submitted. 

If the application is approved, the financial assistance will be disbursed directly to the bank account of the applicant. 

The disbursement is typically made within 30 days of the application approval. 

This scheme is implemented by the Haryana Silicosis Board, which operates under the Department of Labour and Employment, Haryana. 

The board is responsible for the welfare of individuals affected by silicosis and ensures that the benefits of various schemes reach the intended beneficiaries. 

For any queries or assistance, applicants can contact the Haryana Silicosis Board at their official helpline number, which is available on their website. 

The board also conducts awareness programs to educate families about the scheme and the application process. 

Since its launch, the scheme has benefited numerous families across Haryana. 

The Haryana Silicosis Board has reported that thousands of applications have been received, and financial assistance has been disbursed to many families. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Haryana government to support families affected by occupational diseases. 

In addition to the Kanyadaan scheme, the Haryana Silicosis Board offers various other welfare programs aimed at improving the living conditions of affected families. 

These programs include medical assistance, rehabilitation support, and vocational training opportunities. 

The Kanyadaan scheme specifically addresses the cultural significance of marriage in Indian society. 

In many communities, the financial burden of a daughter's marriage can be overwhelming. 

This scheme aims to reduce that burden and promote social equity. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is a significant step towards empowering families affected by silicosis. 

It allows them to celebrate their daughters' marriages without the stress of financial constraints. 

The Haryana government continues to monitor the implementation of this scheme to ensure that it meets its objectives. 

Periodic reviews are conducted to assess the impact of the scheme on the beneficiaries. 

Feedback from the beneficiaries is also taken into consideration for improving the scheme. 

The Kanyadaan scheme is a testament to the Haryana government's commitment to social welfare and support for marginalized communities. 

By providing financial assistance for marriages, the scheme not only helps families financially but also uplifts their social status. 

The scheme reflects the government's recognition of the challenges faced by families affected by silicosis. 

It aims to create a supportive environment that fosters dignity and respect for affected families. 

Overall, the Financial Assistance Scheme for Kanyadaan on the Occasion of Marriage of Daughter is an essential initiative that addresses a critical need in society. 

It exemplifies how targeted financial support can make a significant difference in the lives of individuals and families facing health-related challenges. 

The scheme continues to evolve as the Haryana government seeks to enhance its welfare programs for the benefit of its citizens. 

In conclusion, this scheme is a vital resource for families affected by silicosis in Haryana. 

It provides necessary financial support during a significant life event, ensuring that no family is left behind due to health-related economic hardships. 

The Haryana Silicosis Board remains dedicated to improving the lives of those affected by this occupational disease through various welfare initiatives. 

The Kanyadaan scheme stands out as a beacon of hope for many families in the state.
